messages.subject: Re: Error in tidyLPA
parts:
Hi J.P., we changed how models are specified.

If you are interested in specifying model 2, instead of using the argument model = 2, try the two arguments variances = 'equal' and covariances = 'equal'. That should do the trick.

Josh

On Wed, Nov 14, 2018 at 1:50 PM J. P. Eldous <j.p.e...@gmail.com> wrote:
> m3 <- estimate_profiles(d, 
+                         broad_interest, enjoyment, self_efficacy, 
+                         n_profiles = 3, variances = "equal", print_which_stats = "some",
+                         model = 2)

I was trying out tidyLPA to see if that can be used in longitudinal mixture, and just tried the provided package data of yours but got the error below. Could you help?


Error in estimate_profiles(d, broad_interest, enjoyment, self_efficacy,  : 
  The model command is deprecated in favor of the arguments for the variances and covariances. The models correspond to the following arguments for the variances and covariances:
Model 1: variances = 'equal'; covariances = 'zero';
Model 2: variances = 'equal'; covariances = 'equal';
Model 3: variances = 'equal'; covariances = 'zero';
Model 4: variances = 'varying'; covariances = 'equal' (Cannot be estimated without MPlus);
Model 5: variances = 'equal'; covariances = 'varying' (Cannot be estimated without MPlus);
Model 6: variances = 'varying'; covariances = 'varying';
                     

>compare_solutions(d, broad_interest, enjoyment, self_efficacy)

  Evaluation error: `as_dictionary()` is defunct as of rlang 0.3.0.
Please use `as_data_pronoun()` instead.
